You are rated a score at the end of your run. Your score helps you progress the game, and is used to determine your place on the [https://minmax.gg/dailyspire daily challenge leaderboards] (now defunct).

The table below is additive scoring (for each action performed).

''<sup>Scoring with colored name is overridden by the next modifier with the same colored name, as noted.</sup>''
